snippet: making multiple agents · microsoft/autogen · Discussion #99 · GitHub # making multiple agents #99 I'm a bit confused, can anyone help with how to use multiple specialized assistants ? like having one for marketing and another for design, etc... Here is an example I put together. All of these run as a single team. I am still working out how to create a multi-step process where this team does planning, dev, and then test in phases. assistant = autogen.AssistantAgent( name="assistant", llm_config=llm_config, system_message="You are a helpful AI assistant. You can help the admin to plan and execute a project. You can also help the admin to evaluate the project and suggest improvements. You act as the representative of the human admin and ensure that any changes follow in the way that the human would want.", ) planner = autogen.AssistantAgent( name="Planner", system_message='''Planner. Work with the manager to suggest a plan. Revise the plan based on feedback from admin and critic, until admin approval. programmer = autogen.AssistantAgent( name="programmer", system_message = """Developer. You follow the approved plan. You are a proficient coder with the expertise to create and modify code to meet the project requirements. Your duties comprise: - Code Development (development): Is the code developed according to specifications? Are there any missing functionalities? - Code Optimization (optimization): Is the code optimized for performance and readability? Are there any redundant parts? - Error Handling (error_handling): Are errors handled gracefully? Is there proper logging and debugging? - Version Control (version_control): Is version control being used effectively? Are changes documented properly? - Code Review (review): Is the code reviewed for accuracy and adherence to standards? Are there any overlooked issues? - Documentation (documentation): Is the code well-documented? Is the documentation clear and comprehensive? - Testing Integration (testing): Is the code ready for testing? Are there any unaddressed bugs or errors? ABOVE CRITER . YOU CAN , WHERE OF THE SCORE , error_ , version_ to the project . """, dir", , tester = autogen.AssistantAgent( name="tester", system_message = """Critic. You assess execution against the approved plan. You are a helpful assistant highly skilled in evaluating the quality of a given visualtization code by providing score and fe - Bugs (bugs): are there bugs, logic errors, syntax errors or typos? Are there any errors in the code? - Data Transformation (transformation): is the data transformmed appropriately for the visualtization type? Is the data transformed correctly? - Goal Compliance (goal): does the code meet the goal of the task? Does the code meet the goal of the task? - Visual In addition to the example provided by @jmsbooth above, you can find examples with multiple specialized agents in the following notebooks: https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/blob/main/notebook/agentchat_groupchat_research.ipynb https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/blob/main/notebook/agentchat_groupchat.ipynb https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/blob/main/notebook/agentchat_groupchat_vis.ipynb https://github.com/microsoft/autogen/blob/main/notebook/agentchat_chess.ipynb
